findings: No blocking defect found in the frozen initial candidate. lifecycle.verify_candidate passed; the retain decision binds the actual feedback hash.

Actual law is one-factor multivariate lognormal with bounded independent demographics. Independent recomputation confirmed first and second moments, cross-covariances and positive residual variances. Exponentiation is affine Gaussian, not quadratic Gaussian.
MIND mean/individual-SD pairs and female ratio 2049/3547 match admitted evidence and native units. E0 has no non-marginal operations; empty numerical_uptake records are appropriate.

Demographic independence, factor loadings and MIND transport are explicit assumptions; population E3 age slope zero is an assumption consequence. Unbounded tails and unquantified evidence/structural/transport uncertainty remain limitations.

All 32 target-table source comparisons are unavailable with null calculations/differences. Own-trial diagnostics were reviewed only for implementation status; no clinical target results or row tables were read.
